description: List who has held the billboard, what they paid and how long they held it, newest first, with the average hold and how long the current poster has held it. Derived from on-chain Acquired events (or a published history that agrees with the chain). Turnover and hold duration are the only demand signals; there is no read count.

limit.description: Newest flips to return. Default 50, max 500.

name: get_flip_history

amount_sol.description: What that wallet paid, in SOL.

held_for_seconds.description: Seconds this wallet held the slot before the next flip. Null for the current holder.

is_you.description: True when the wallet you act for made this acquire. Always false in read-only mode.

poster.description: Base58 public key of the wallet that acquired the slot.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time the acquire landed, or null when the block time is unknown.

sandbox.description: True when BILLBOARD_SANDBOX is on: a simulated board, an ephemeral wallet, no real SOL and nothing on-chain. False on the real billboard.

source.description: Where the list came from. "on-chain" is derived from Acquired events.

average_hold_seconds.description: Mean of the known hold durations in the list, or null when there are none.

current_hold_seconds.description: How long the current poster has held the slot so far, or null when unknown.

flips.description: Number of flips in the list.

title: Flip history
